name: Interest Rate Derivative 5
definition: Specifies the interest rate derivative specific elements for interest rate derivatives as defined in the local regulation.

UnderlyingType.name: Underlying Type
UnderlyingType.definition: Specific details on the underlying type of the interest rate derivative.

UnderlyingBond.name: Underlying Bond
UnderlyingBond.definition: Populated when the underlying type is a bond or a bond future. Details the issuer and maturity date of the bond.

UnderlyingSwapMaturityDate.name: Underlying Swap Maturity Date
UnderlyingSwapMaturityDate.definition: Maturity date of the underlying swap, populated for swaptions, futures on swaps and forwards on a swap only.

InflationIndex.name: Inflation Index
InflationIndex.definition: Populated to define the inflation index.

InterestRateReference.name: Interest Rate Reference
InterestRateReference.definition: Provides the interest rate against a reference rate and term in number of days, weeks, months or years.
